Three-step trace U/P and determinant V/P satisfy P−U+V=6Xs^4q2, P+U+V=XH_plus, P−V=XH_det, all strictly positive for x,y,z>0; the independent symbolic reconstruction verified each identity and every coefficient of H_plus and H_det positive. Along (t,1,t^−1), the independently reconstructed rational expressions satisfy trace=−1+16/(3t)+O(t^-2), det=1/(3t³)+O(t^-4), proving nonattained supremum 1. No claim for nonperiodic grids.

final_claim: For homogeneous variable-step BDF3 with any fixed strictly positive three-periodic pattern (x,y,z), its 2×2 parasitic Floquet multiplier matrix F has ρ(F)<1; over all positive patterns the supremum is 1 but unattained, and along (t,1,t^−1) it equals 1−16/(3t)+O(t^−2). This establishes fixed-pattern zero-stability, not a mesh-uniform gap.
